Like the nitrile rubber, these viton seals have extended service lives, reducing the need for maintenance and replacement.Improved Sealing PerformanceHMSA10 seals like the 80X100X12 HMSA10V offer improved sealing performance through features like an optimized rubber outside diameter and spring-loaded sealing lips.
